messages.author: d097239898b13d0a
messages.subject: Re: ggtree shows a completely different tree than the one I can see in Dendroscope
parts:
The topologies of the trees are identical. Remember, that there is no 'correct' order to a tree. It's an object that you can rotate in multi-dimensional space and the information doesn't change. I think some more reading on your part will help you understand how phylogenetic trees work and why the two original trees you sent out are identical.

Karl

messages.subject: Re: ggtree shows a completely different tree than the one I can see in Dendroscope
parts: Thanks, I'll check it out.

On Wed, 27 Feb 2019, 6:45 am Yu, Guangchuang, <gc...@connect.hku.hk> wrote:

You definitely should follow Karl's suggestion to learn more about phylogeny.

BTW: what you need is the rotate and flip functions described in https://yulab-smu.github.io/treedata-book/chapter6.html#exploring-tree-structure.


On Wed, Feb 27, 2019 at 1:28 AM Karl Fetter <karl....@gmail.com> wrote:
The topologies of the trees are identical. Remember, that there is no 'correct' order to a tree. It's an object that you can rotate in multi-dimensional space and the information doesn't change. I think some more reading on your part will help you understand how phylogenetic trees work and why the two original trees you sent out are identical.

Karl


On Feb 26, 2019, at 11:26 AM, haghdoost...@gmail.com wrote:

Thank you for your fast reply.
I tried your suggestion. but it again shows a completely different tree!
Although the names are the same as our original tree, but the branches are differently arranged...
their arrangement is very important for my paper...
What do you think causes this problem?
attached is the screenshot of the new tree with   ladderize = FALSE

On Tuesday, 26 February 2019 17:33:26 UTC+3:30, Yu, Guangchuang wrote:

from the screenshot, I can assure you that the trees have identical structure.

try ggtree(tree, ladderize = FALSE).


On Tue, Feb 26, 2019 at 9:56 PM <haghdoost...@gmail.com> wrote:

I never had such a problem with ggtree before... It always showed the same tree as the dendroscope...
Thanks

On Tuesday, 26 February 2019 12:17:56 UTC+3:30, Yu, Guangchuang wrote:
you should provide a screenshot and point it out what's the difference.
